Implement the Verilog module based on the following description. Assume that signals are positive clock/clk edge triggered unless otherwise stated.

Correct the syntax error in the code.

Reply with the complete corrected module in a ```verilog code block.

Problem Description:
For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).

module top_module(
	input clk,
	input reset,
	input [31:0] in,
	output reg [31:0] out);

Erroneous Implementation:

always @(posedge clk)
begin
	if (reset)
		out <= 0;
	else
		out <= out | ~in & d_last;
end

endmodule

Feedback:

1 error(s) during elaboration.
